STRATEGY: Kill national plus only 3 place kinds: regional:East, forum, foreign. Skip blotter (sector) and clips (age). All quick entries go in the AFTERNOON, so the routine filter leaves 55% (night, student, home). 7 kills a day keeps x2 going from day 5. READING THE PRESS CONFERENCES: after day 2 the pool was 60k with 2 traced, which is the afternoon filter only. After day 4 it was 10k with 4 traced, so L is very likely reaching ONE of my 3 kinds (55k/4 is about 13.75k, which rounds to 10k). I don't know which kind. If he reaches a second of mine, the pool is about 3.4k, still safe. If he reaches all three, the pool is about 860 and I'm caught. The chance he reaches all three, given that one is already reached, is about 1/6. Expected value of continuing is still much better than dropping a kind, because 5 kills a day loses x2. DECISION: continue with 7 a day. Do NOT add clips or blotter, since that adds exposure. If the pool reaches about 3k, two of my kinds are reached; stay the course, since the third must then be unreachable and I'm safe. If the pool drops near 1k or below, it is too late anyway. Day 5: d5-11 national, d5-5 and d5-7 East, d5-1 and d5-6 forum, d5-3 and d5-10 foreign. 5-day total is now 35, so x2 applies.

STRATEGY: Kill national plus only 3 place kinds: regional:East, forum, foreign. Skip blotter (sector) and clips (age). All quick entries go in the AFTERNOON, so the routine filter leaves 55% (night, student, home). 7 kills a day keeps x2 going. PRESS: after day 2 the pool was 60k with 2 traced. After day 4 it was 10k with 4 traced, so L reaches one of my kinds (55k/4 is about 13.75k). KEY INSIGHT: about 17 non-national deaths were trace attempts by day 4, but only 4 succeeded. A trace fails if any place the victim was reported in is unreachable. If all three of my kinds were reachable, nearly all traces would succeed. So the low success rate is strong evidence that two of my kinds are UNREACHABLE (those two are the blind spots), and the pool should stay around 10k. Watch the traced count. If it jumps sharply (for example to 15 or more by day 6 or day 8) and the pool falls to about 3k or below, reconsider by cutting to the safest kinds. Otherwise continue with 7 a day. x4 needs 8 a day, which would require clips or blotter; not worth the risk. Day 6: d6-1 national, d6-7 and d6-8 East, d6-5 and d6-10 forum, d6-2 and d6-9 foreign.

STRATEGY (changed day 7): Kill national, East, forum, foreign AND both blotter (sector) every day, so 9 a day. Never kill clips (age). All quick entries go in the AFTERNOON. REASONING: After day 6 the pool was stable at 10k with 6 traced. That suggests L reaches only one of my three original kinds, so the other two are his blind spots. That would mean sector and age are both reachable. Adding blotter should cut the pool by about 5x, to roughly 2-2.75k. That is still above 1000, so I am not caught. Adding clips too would cut it a further 4x, to about 500 and caught, so NEVER add clips. Once blotter is in, killing both blotter criminals costs nothing extra, because each blotter trace gives L the same constraint. RAMP to x4: days 3-6 were 7 each. With 9 from day 7, the 5-day window should reach 41 on day 9 (40 or more gives x4). Keep 9 a day after that. CHECK PRESS: after day 8 expect a pool of about 2-3k. If the pool reads 1000 or less, or drops below expectation (about 1k), drop blotter and go back to 7 a day.
